lines.not_deep: A little deeper, if it's comfortable.
lines.not_upright: Stand up tall at the top.
lines.not_straight: Straighten your knee a bit more.
lines.no_hold: Hold it straight for two seconds.
lines.not_high: Lift a little higher, to shoulder height.
lines.steady: Nice effort. Make the next one slow and steady.
lines.start_squat: Camera's ready. Let's do the chair squat. Take your time.
lines.start_sit_to_stand: Camera's ready. Let's do sit to stand. Take your time.
lines.start_arm_raise: Camera's ready. Let's do the arm raise, out to the side. Take your time.
lines.set_done: That's the set. Take a breather, then carry on.
lines.all_done: Nice work. That's all of them.
